task: GitHub issue #30: KnowledgeBase thread safety — check_same_thread=False + RLock around all operations

acceptance.criterion: (1) concurrent run, 2+ remember steps, max_workers=2 -> succeeded
acceptance.evidence: tests/test_memory.py::test_concurrent_remember_steps_succeed — 2 set calls on ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) both succeed; KB.get returns correct values

acceptance.criterion: (2) KB methods callable from a non-creator thread
acceptance.evidence: tests/test_memory.py::test_kb_callable_from_non_creator_thread — KB created on main thread, set/get/__contains__/recall/keys all called from worker thread without error

acceptance.criterion: (3) parallel remember+recall of one key never tears
acceptance.evidence: tests/test_memory.py::test_parallel_remember_and_recall_never_tears — 40 set + 40 recall on 4 threads; no exceptions; final get returns a valid value containing 'deploy value'; keys() returns exactly 1 key

test_recall_ranks_matching_key_first, test_delete_removes_key_from_recall, test_recall_empty_kb_returns_empty, test_recall_lazy_creation_on_old_db all pass; FTS5 recall surface and exact-key grammar unchanged (only locking added)
PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m pytest -q -> 860 passed in 20.36s (857 baseline + 3 new)

acceptance.criterion: git status --porcelain shows ONLY owned files
acceptance.evidence: git status --porcelain: M src/tahoe/memory.py, M tests/test_memory.py, ?? demo/runs/sprint2-30-kb-threads/ — all within owned file scope
